sources.title: Entry visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The current guidance is published on the Foreign Ministry's official fm.gov.om domain and identifies the Royal Oman Police as the visitor-visa authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of other nationalities can establish their visa options via the ROP’s eVisa website.

sources.title: Visa-Free Entry Countries
sources.officialityEvidence: The nationality lists are published on the Royal Oman Police's official rop.gov.om domain.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List No. (1): Countries that can be entered without a tourist visa

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.officialityEvidence: The current FAQ is published on the Royal Oman Police eVisa subdomain, but it now exposes no substantive ordinary-visitor eligibility or issuance guidance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: To view your Visa Application Status, please login and proceed to the 'Find Visa Application' link.

sources.title: Visa Eligibility Wizard - Unsponsored Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Royal Oman Police eVisa eligibility wizard is the authority's operational unsponsored-visa interface.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Your answers will determine which visa types are available to you.

sources.title: Visa types
sources.officialityEvidence: The live ROP eVisa service publishes distinct sponsored and unsponsored visit-visa classes, without an exhaustive nationality-to-class schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visit Sponsored visas ... Visit Unsponsored visas

conflicts.explanation: ROP currently places Taiwan in List No. (1), while the Foreign Ministry's current exemption groups omit it; no source resolves the ordinary-passport result.

unresolved.reason: The current Foreign Ministry page directs other nationalities to the ROP eVisa service but does not publish an exhaustive nationality-to-route map. ROP publishes sponsored and unsponsored visit classes, while its eligibility wizard asks both passport nationality and GCC residence; no unconditional ordinary-short-visitor route or residual prior-visa timing is established for this code. Portal form availability or omission is not treated as proof.
